# Intermediate Representation — ServoPNP
Station number: 1
Description: Two-axis servo pick and place with sensorless timer gripper; fast/slow transition-point motion with blended corners.

## Devices
- [ServoAxis] HorizontalAxis "Horizontal_Axis" sensorArrangement="" homePosition="ServoMove" axisNumber=1 motionType="linear" positions=[{"name":"Home","defaultValue":0,"moveType":"Pos","isHome":true,"isRecipe":false,"type":"position"},{"name":"Pick","defaultValue":350,"moveType":"Pos","isHome":false,"isRecipe":false,"type":"position"},{"name":"Place","defaultValue":50,"moveType":"Pos","isHome":false,"isRecipe":false,"type":"position"}] speedProfiles=[{"name":"Slow","speed":150,"accel":1500,"decel":1500},{"name":"Fast","speed":2500,"accel":25000,"decel":25000}] extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=250 disengageTimerMs=250 vacOnTimerMs=300 hasEject=false timerMs=1000
- [ServoAxis] VerticalAxis "Vertical_Axis" sensorArrangement="" homePosition="ServoMove" axisNumber=2 motionType="linear" positions=[{"name":"Retract","defaultValue":0,"moveType":"Pos","isHome":true,"isRecipe":false,"type":"position"},{"name":"PickTransition","defaultValue":60,"moveType":"Pos","isHome":false,"isRecipe":false,"type":"position"},{"name":"Pick","defaultValue":100,"moveType":"Pos","isHome":false,"isRecipe":false,"type":"position"},{"name":"PlaceTransition","defaultValue":60,"moveType":"Pos","isHome":false,"isRecipe":false,"type":"position"},{"name":"Place","defaultValue":100,"moveType":"Pos","isHome":false,"isRecipe":false,"type":"position"}] speedProfiles=[{"name":"Slow","speed":100,"accel":1000,"decel":1000},{"name":"Fast","speed":2000,"accel":20000,"decel":20000}] extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=250 disengageTimerMs=250 vacOnTimerMs=300 hasEject=false timerMs=1000
- [PneumaticGripper] PartGripper "Part_Gripper" sensorArrangement="No sensors" homePosition="Disengage" axisNumber=1 extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=250 disengageTimerMs=250 vacOnTimerMs=300 hasEject=false timerMs=1000

## States (assigned state numbers — these are FINAL, use them as-is)
- State 4: "Home / Wait for Start (Vertical at Retract)" {INITIAL}
- State 7: "Horizontal Fast to Pick"
    action: ServoMove -> HorizontalAxis (positionName="Pick" speedProfile="Fast" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 10: "Vertical Fast Down to Pick Transition"
    action: ServoMove -> VerticalAxis (positionName="PickTransition" speedProfile="Fast" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 13: "Vertical Slow Down to Pick"
    action: ServoMove -> VerticalAxis (positionName="Pick" speedProfile="Slow" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 16: "Close Gripper (250 ms Timer)"
    action: Engage -> PartGripper (advanceCondition={"type":"timer","timerMs":250})
- State 19: "Vertical Slow Up to Pick Transition"
    action: ServoMove -> VerticalAxis (positionName="PickTransition" speedProfile="Slow" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 22: "Vertical Fast to Retract; Horizontal Blends to Place"
    action: ServoMove -> VerticalAxis (positionName="Retract" speedProfile="Fast" advanceCondition={"type":"none"})
    action: ServoMove -> HorizontalAxis (positionName="Place" speedProfile="Fast" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 25: "Vertical Fast Down to Place Transition (Blended Corner)"
    action: ServoMove -> VerticalAxis (positionName="PlaceTransition" speedProfile="Fast" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 28: "Vertical Slow Down to Place"
    action: ServoMove -> VerticalAxis (positionName="Place" speedProfile="Slow" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 31: "Open Gripper (250 ms Timer)"
    action: Disengage -> PartGripper (advanceCondition={"type":"timer","timerMs":250})
- State 34: "Vertical Slow Up to Place Transition"
    action: ServoMove -> VerticalAxis (positionName="PlaceTransition" speedProfile="Slow" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 37: "Vertical Fast to Retract; Horizontal Blends to Home"
    action: ServoMove -> VerticalAxis (positionName="Retract" speedProfile="Fast" advanceCondition={"type":"none"})
    action: ServoMove -> HorizontalAxis (positionName="Home" speedProfile="Fast" advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
- State 40: "Wait for Next-Cycle Signal"
    action: Wait -> _decision (nodeMode="wait" signalName="NextCycleRequest" signalSource="Supervisor" signalType="condition" conditionType="sensorOn" exitCount=1 exit1Label="On" exit2Label="Off")
- State 43: "Cycle Complete" {CYCLE-COMPLETE}

## Transitions
- [4] "Home / Wait for Start (Vertical at Retract)" -> [7] "Horizontal Fast to Pick" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [7] "Horizontal Fast to Pick" -> [10] "Vertical Fast Down to Pick Transition" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [10] "Vertical Fast Down to Pick Transition" -> [13] "Vertical Slow Down to Pick" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [13] "Vertical Slow Down to Pick" -> [16] "Close Gripper (250 ms Timer)" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [16] "Close Gripper (250 ms Timer)" -> [19] "Vertical Slow Up to Pick Transition" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [19] "Vertical Slow Up to Pick Transition" -> [22] "Vertical Fast to Retract; Horizontal Blends to Place" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [22] "Vertical Fast to Retract; Horizontal Blends to Place" -> [25] "Vertical Fast Down to Place Transition (Blended Corner)" (type=verify label="HorizontalAxisiq_MAM.PC=On
HorizontalAxisiq_PlaceRC.In_Range=On")
- [25] "Vertical Fast Down to Place Transition (Blended Corner)" -> [28] "Vertical Slow Down to Place" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [28] "Vertical Slow Down to Place" -> [31] "Open Gripper (250 ms Timer)" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [31] "Open Gripper (250 ms Timer)" -> [34] "Vertical Slow Up to Place Transition" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [34] "Vertical Slow Up to Place Transition" -> [37] "Vertical Fast to Retract; Horizontal Blends to Home" (type=ready label="Ready")
- [37] "Vertical Fast to Retract; Horizontal Blends to Home" -> [40] "Wait for Next-Cycle Signal" (type=verify label="HorizontalAxisiq_MAM.PC=On
HorizontalAxisiq_HomeRC.In_Range=On")
- [40] "Wait for Next-Cycle Signal" -> [43] "Cycle Complete" (type=ready label="NextCycleRequest=On")

## MACHINE SPEC (mechanical intent — compile the coordination)
This section is AUTHORITATIVE intent authored by the mechanical engineer.
Synthesize the signals, waits, exits, and cross-station handshakes that
realize it. EVERY wait you create must have an exit for every partner
failure mode listed here PLUS a timeout — no exitless waits.

Station purpose: A standalone 2-axis servo pick-and-place that picks a part at the pick position and places it at the place position, looping on a next-cycle signal.

### Device purposes
- Horizontal_Axis: Traverses between pick, place, and home positions.
- Vertical_Axis: Raises and lowers the gripper into the pick and place positions, with a safe retract height.
- Part_Gripper: Holds the part during transfer; sensorless, timer-based open/close.

### Outcome rules (verbatim — each one needs a reachable path in the program)
- WHEN: Any fault during the cycle -> DO: Recover by first moving the vertical axis up to the safe/retract height before doing anything else..
- WHEN: Recovery with the gripper commanded closed -> DO: Assume a part is held and go to the place sequence..
- WHEN: Recovery with the gripper commanded open -> DO: Assume no part is held and return to the pick sequence..
